full_prompt_en: A square anime-style ensemble illustration gathers several sharply dressed figures against a warm orange background. The flat backdrop darkens at the vertical sides and carries a grainy paper texture, leaving the group like a theatrical poster without visible lettering. In the front center, a pale blond man faces outward with a composed smile. His rust-red suit jacket and trousers frame a black vest, white shirt, and narrow dark tie; both hands rest in his pockets. To his left, a blond woman in a red sleeveless dress and choker turns slightly toward him, one hand raised near her shoulder. Her curled bob and pale skin catch the light. To the right, a red-haired woman in a fitted black dress looks outward with a more alert expression and holds a small dark object near her shoulder. Behind the center figure, a man with glasses and a broad black hat stands in profile, his gloved hand near his face. At the upper right, a brown-haired man in a coat holds a smoking pipe, a small pale curl of smoke rising into the orange field. Another dark-haired figure in a light brown coat occupies the far left, partly turned away. The heads overlap in two shallow rows, their different angles creating movement without a depicted location. Warm amber lighting is diffuse and even, with pale highlights on hair and faces and deeper brown shadows in coats and collars. Clean fine contours articulate facial features and garments; broader flat color areas and soft textured transitions prevent the image from looking purely cel-shaded. The overall composition is compact and confident, using rust, black, cream, and gold to give the group a vintage dramatic mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画风格群像插图让几名衣着考究的人物聚在暖橙色背景前。平面背景在两侧竖边变暗，带有颗粒纸张肌理，使群像仿佛戏剧海报，却没有可见文字。前景中央，一名浅金发男子面向画外，露出克制笑容。锈红色西装外套与长裤围住黑背心、白衬衫和窄深色领带；双手插在口袋里。左侧，一名金发女子穿红色无袖裙、戴颈圈，略朝他转身，一只手抬在肩旁。卷曲短发和浅色肌肤接住光。右侧，一名红发女子穿贴身黑裙，以更警觉的表情向外看，并在肩旁握着小型深色物件。中央人物身后，一名戴眼镜与宽檐黑帽的男子以侧面站立，戴手套的手靠近脸。右上方，一名棕发男子穿外套，叼着烟斗，细小浅色烟线升入橙色场域。另一名深发人物穿浅棕外套占据最左边，身体部分转开。人物头部重叠为两层浅近队列，不同朝向产生动感，却没有描绘具体地点。暖琥珀色照明漫射而均匀，在头发和面容留下浅高光，在外套与衣领里留有更深棕影。清楚的细轮廓刻画五官和服饰；较宽的平面色区与柔和肌理过渡使图像不只是纯粹的赛璐珞平涂。整体构图紧凑而自信，以锈色、黑色、奶油色和金色赋予人物群像复古戏剧气氛。
style_prompt_en: The animated illustration combines clean fine contours, expressive simplified faces, broad clothing color blocks, and warm grainy transitions. Burnt orange, rust, tobacco brown, cream, and near-black make a narrow vintage palette; pale highlights focus attention amid darker outer masses. Layered silhouettes overlap in shallow depth, with heads placed at staggered heights and angles for ensemble rhythm. Diffuse amber light rounds the faces softly while leaving garments more graphic and flat. Paperlike speckling and brushed fade at the edges soften the crisp interior linework. The composition feels theatrical and lively without complex scenery, with color contrast and interlocking forms providing its visual force.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅动画插图结合干净细轮廓、表现性简化面容、宽阔衣料色块和带颗粒的暖色过渡。焦橙、锈色、烟草棕、奶油色和近黑色构成狭窄复古色域；浅色高光在较深外缘体块之间集中注意力。层叠剪影以浅纵深重叠，头部高低与角度错开，形成群像节奏。漫射琥珀光轻柔地让面容圆润，衣物却更图形化、更平坦。纸张般斑点与边缘擦开的褪色缓和内部清晰线条。构图有戏剧性而生动，无需复杂景物，色彩对照和咬合形体提供视觉力量。
theme_en: An ensemble of sharply dressed animated characters against a warm orange field
theme_zh: 暖橙色背景前衣着考究的动画人物群像
name: Baccano
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
